children.text: Carpool is a revolutionary application designed to make commuting easier and more affordable. Built using React Native for the frontend, and powered by a robust backend stack of Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and TypeScript, Carpool connects riders and drivers for shared cab rides, reducing travel costs and promoting eco-friendly transportation.
: Find and share rides with others heading in the same direction. Carpool makes it simple to connect with fellow commuters, reducing the cost and environmental impact of your travels.
: Plan your rides ahead of time with our scheduling feature. Whether it’s a daily commute or a one-time trip, Carpool allows you to book rides in advance.
: Communicate with your fellow riders and drivers directly within the app using our secure chat feature. Coordination has never been easier.
: Developed with React Native, Carpool offers a sleek and intuitive interface, ensuring a seamless user experience across both iOS and Android platforms.
: Built with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, Carpool ensures data security and reliability, providing users with a safe and trustworthy environment for their ride-sharing needs.
: Leveraging TypeScript for the backend, Carpool provides enhanced code quality and maintainability, ensuring a stable and efficient application performance.
: By promoting shared rides, Carpool helps reduce the number of vehicles on the road, contributing to lower carbon emissions and a healthier planet.
Join Carpool today and start saving money, making new friends, and reducing your carbon footprint. Together, we can make commuting a better experience for everyone.

SmartInvest is a cutting-edge financial application built using React Native for the frontend, with a robust backend powered by Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and TypeScript. This app provides an innovative way to manage and grow your wealth through its inbuilt currency called SmartCoin.
: Easily deposit dollars and convert them into SmartCoins within the app. This feature ensures a smooth and hassle-free transaction process.
: SmartInvest offers a variety of investment packages tailored to meet different financial goals. Users can subscribe to these packages to stake their SmartCoins.
: By staking SmartCoins in the selected packages, users can earn a consistent monthly profit, enhancing their wealth growth over time.
: Developed with React Native, SmartInvest boasts a sleek and intuitive interface, ensuring an optimal user experience across both iOS and Android platforms.
: Built with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, SmartInvest ensures data security and reliability, providing users with a safe environment for their financial activities.
: Leveraging TypeScript for the backend, SmartInvest offers enhanced code quality and maintainability, ensuring a stable and efficient application performance.
With SmartInvest, managing and growing your wealth has never been easier. Transform your financial journey with SmartCoin and start earning monthly profits today!

📕 TutorZone - Empowering Education 📕

I'm thrilled to present TutorZone, an innovative platform where teachers can share their skills and students can enroll in the classes that interest them the most.

Project Highlights:
🎉 Designed and developed the front end using React Native, ensuring a smooth and intuitive user experience for both iOS/Android platforms.
📚 Skill Sharing: Teachers can easily create and manage classes to share their expertise with eager learners.
👩‍🏫👨‍🎓 Student Enrollment: Students can browse and enroll in a wide range of classes offered by diverse teachers.
💡 Seamless UI: Utilized the NativeBase component library to create a cohesive and user-friendly interface.

Working on TutorZone allowed me to explore the intricacies of front-end development and user interface design. This project honed my skills in creating intuitive navigation and engaging layouts, ensuring a seamless experience for both teachers and students.

I'm proud to have contributed to a platform that fosters learning and skill development, making education more accessible and personalized. The collaboration with my team on this project was incredibly rewarding, pushing us to innovate and enhance the user experience continuously.
